name: Phone coordinator-mail relay (Mac launchd agent)
purpose: every 60 s (launchd com.powos.coordinator-relay, tools/agents/coordinator-relay.py from the $POWOS_RUN_ROOT/verify-runner checkout, default ~/pw/verify-runner): while the phone answers on the VPN (tools/phone/adb.sh --vpn-state), peeks the phone's `powos comms` inbox of the coordinator role (mail from PowOS mobile's manager), appends new messages by id to ~/.cache/powos-coordinator-inbox.jsonl plus one summary line each to ~/.cache/powos-coordinator-inbox.log (what the Mac coordinator watches), then marks exactly those ids read on the phone. Replies: tools/agents/reply-phone.sh. Read-only on the phone otherwise
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; a short python pass every 60 s: one docker exec (WireGuard handshake age) while the phone is off, two adb calls capped at 90 s each while it answers
